name: Smart Woo Search (SWS)
author: abhishek

sections.description:
Smart Woo Search (SWS) is a powerful yet lightweight plugin designed to enhance the default WordPress search functionality. This plugin allows users to search woocommerce product.

Features:

  • Search across woocommerce products
  • Filter search results by title.
  • AJAX based functionality.
  • Developer-friendly code.

License

sections.installation:
From the WordPress Dashboard:

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Smart Woo Search (SWS).”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Extract the contents and upload the Smart Woo Search (SWS) folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Q: Does this plugin work with custom post types?

A: No

Q: Can I customize the search results page?

No

Q: Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

A: Yes, the plugin can enhance product search functionality in WooCommerce.
